subject: general
question: Which Indian javelin thrower has been suspended in 2022 (till 2025) for doping?
solution:
The correct answer is Shivpal Singh.

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

__
 
• Indian javelin thrower Shivpal Singh has been suspended from competing till October 2025 due to a doping violation.
 
• He tested positive for the banned substance methandienone, a performance-enhancing steroid.
 
• Uttar Pradesh-based, Shivpal was a silver-medallist at the 2019 Asian Championships.
 
• Earlier, Discus thrower Navjeet Kaur Dhillon was also banned due to doping violations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**The World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA):

 
• The World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) is an international independent agency.
 
• WADA was established in 1999.
 
• It is headquartered in Montreal, Canada.
 
• President: Witold Bańka
 
• It was set up as a foundation under the initiative of the International Olympic Committee (IOC) with the support and participation of intergovernmental organizations, governments, public authorities, and other public and private bodies fighting doping in sports.
 
• WADA is responsible for the World Anti-Doping Code, adopted by more than 650 sports organizations.
 
• It aims to lead a collaborative worldwide movement for doping-free sport.
